settings.batch.footer: Choose a bookmarks JSON exported by the Twitter Web Exporter userscript; posts are downloaded one by one. Concurrency is how many posts download at once; the interval is the wait before each post starts. With many posts, lower concurrency and a longer interval are safer. Starting again after an interruption continues with the unfinished posts. Method and folder follow the settings at the top.
settings.browse.footer: “Sound Only with Headphones”: without headphones, videos start muted and ask whether to turn sound on. “Disable Gestures in Video Player”: dragging in the player no longer changes position, volume or brightness (press-and-hold speed-up and double-tap pause still work); swipe sideways in a post to move between photos and videos, drag down to close the player. When off, arrows on both sides of the player go to the previous and next item.
settings.cookie.footer: Sign in to x.com in a browser and copy auth_token and ct0 from the developer tools' cookies. Stored only in this device's keychain, never synced.

settings.maintenance.footer: A check verifies every file to find damaged or missing media. Diagnostics contain only error records and counts — no pictures, text, tag names or cookies.
settings.method.footer: Applies to the links below and to batch bookmark imports. “Automatic” tries the public mirror FxTwitter first; when that fails (a protected account, say) and a cookie is set, it downloads with the account. Posts already in the library go into the chosen folder too.
settings.paused.footer: Paused jobs must be resumed by hand. Canceling removes unfinished jobs; what was downloaded stays.
settings.search.footer: In the search field, type a condition word (Tags, Text, User, Mine, AI, Common, Videos, Photos, Folder, Recent, Imported) and a space to make it a condition capsule; any other word and a space becomes something to search for, in any order. Without Tags, Text or User, tags, post text and authors are all searched. A minus in front leaves something out (-word, -User). Fuzzy search: matches what contains the word, plus tags close in meaning.
settings.signOut.footer: Signs this browser out of the web app. Other browsers stay signed in; to sign everyone out, change the password with twimshelf passwd.
settings.stats.footer: Compare these numbers on each device to check that sync is complete.
